instruction: Implement only the requirement in the frozen browser page. Replace the single /* MODEL_BEHAVIOR */ marker with vanilla JavaScript statements using the provided app API. Register app.onRestore to handle the visible Restore button. Do not change any other byte of the page. Return only the complete HTML page.

arms.A: When a deleted file is restored, return it to its original location when that location exists and is writable. If an active file already has the same name there, give the restored file a unique name.
arms.B: Restore a deleted file to its original writable location. If that location already contains a file with the deleted item's name, rename the restored item so its name is unique.
arms.C: When a deleted file is restored, return it to its original location when that location exists and is writable.
